name: Spain total solar eclipse access and activity restrictions — 12 August 2026

metadata.scope: Published restrictions and announced controls relevant to reaching or using eclipse-viewing locations in Spain's 12 August 2026 eclipse corridor.
metadata.important_limit: This is a snapshot, not a guarantee of completeness on eclipse day. Wildfire orders, police controls, capacity closures and municipal measures can change at short notice.
metadata.geometry_policy: GeoJSON geometry is null when the issuing authority did not publish a polygon/coordinate or when geocoding would risk falsely narrowing a legal restriction. Use properties.map_query, road_code and road_reference for geocoding or matching to an authoritative road/land dataset.

status_policy.planned_not_final: Officially announced as proposed/expected, but final detailed order still pending.
status_policy.reported_confirmed: Reported by reputable media as an authority-announced measure; primary order/page not located.
status_policy.provisional_confirmed_list: Authority-origin list reported as provisional and still subject to updates.
status_policy.confirmed_framework_details_pending: Official framework exists, but exact local control points/hours are pending.

excluded_from_features: Generic safety advice and non-binding recommendations.
National or regional special-traffic-plan designations that authorize future controls but do not themselves close a place.
Conditional wildfire-access mechanisms not active specifically for 12 August at snapshot time.
Temporary current wildfire closures with no evidence they will remain active on 12 August.
Possible Castilla-La Mancha exclusion zones that have not yet been named or finalized.

jurisdictions_reviewed.result: No fixed eclipse-day access/area closure located in the reviewed official sources as of snapshot.
Regionwide fire-related activity suspension included; no general mountain/forest entry ban found.
Heavy-vehicle road-network ban included; no passenger-car viewing-area ban found.
Heavy-goods-vehicle road-network ban included; forest-track avoidance remains advice, not a blanket legal entry ban.
No fixed eclipse-wide mountain/forest entry ban or named exclusion list located as of snapshot.
No fixed eclipse-day access/area closure located as of snapshot.
Possible exclusion zones are under analysis, but no named final list was published; therefore none included.
Zaragoza city rules and planned bridge/footbridge closures included. No verified autonomous-community-wide mountain ban included.
Heavy-vehicle corridor restrictions, municipal access-regulation framework and Ebro Observatory closure included.
L'Albufera/Devesa closure and CV-500/El Palmar access controls included from municipal-announcement reporting.
Official island-by-island access-control table and special municipal closures included.
